## What to write

It lifts #24932 ruling B item 4 (comment 6303721609) and the ⛔ at `docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md:295-297` ("interim removal of the predicate for an unrestricted master scope …") for **one reader class only**: a reader who holds view-all on the detail and whose every master hop answers unrestricted, with a required master FK. That reader sees null and dangling-FK detail rows inside its tenant wall, consistent with #30905 ruling A (ADR-0055, 11-06). Every other reader keeps the chain.

2. ADR-0055: a matching note beside the 2026-10-22 revision and the #30905 ruling A section, so the "rows with no master" rule reads as one statement.
